entities.summary: Alexander Borisovich Belyavsky was a Soviet/Russian actor who appeared in more than one hundred films. Belyavsky was also the first presenter of the popular TV Show The 13 Chairs Tavern. In 1988, he was designated a Meritorious Artist of Russia; in 2003, he was named a People's Artist of Russia.
